Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 2D wuxia RPG combat visual-effect sprite sheet.
Primary request: a four-frame effect for the combat family heavy blade ground rupture with a short natural flame eruption, no dragon or creature motif.
Layout: a strict 2 by 2 grid, each cell exactly one equal square frame, no borders, no labels, no frame numbers. Read left-to-right then top-to-bottom.
Frame 1: a narrow amber ground fissure starting beneath one concentrated downward impact point, with a few small stones lifting.
Frame 2: the same fissure widening into a jagged split from top-left to bottom-right, hot orange light visible inside and dust pushed outward.

Scene/backdrop: a perfectly flat solid #FF00FF chroma-key background across every cell.

网络红人脸，二次元萌系，迪士尼风，
